subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Which automatic reset hook contract should OpenClaw support for daily and idle rollover memory persistence?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the permanent API shape affects internal hooks, typed plugin hooks, and upgrade-visible session behavior, so automation should not choose it alone.

options.title: Refine the active reset PR
options.body: Accept command-style daily/idle reset events plus lazy before_reset dispatch as the narrow fix path, then require real rollover proof and docs alignment before merge.

options.title: Define a typed session reset event
options.body: Pause the active PR and design a session:reset or session:before-reset surface before wiring bundled session-memory to it.

options.title: Use lifecycle hooks only
options.body: Keep automatic rollover on existing typed session_end/session_start or before_reset semantics and adapt memory persistence around that contract instead of adding command-style actions.

recommendation.title: Refine the active reset PR
recommendation.body: Accept command-style daily/idle reset events plus lazy before_reset dispatch as the narrow fix path, then require real rollover proof and docs alignment before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is connected to the current-main hook/session-memory lines and the active candidate branch repair, making them the best available owner for the hook contract choice.
